name: Tatsunokuchi (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Tatsunokuchi town emblem in yellow: a disc crossed by a green diagonal stroke, with a hooked stroke at the top.
history: Flag of the former town of Tatsunokuchi in Ishikawa Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-02-01.

features.role: Tatsunokuchi town emblem — a disc crossed by a green diagonal stroke, with a hooked stroke at the top
